summary: Verified new emergency endpoint POST /api/admin/disable-2fa. 9 new tests all pass (auth 401 for missing/wrong X-Admin-Key, 404 for unknown email, 422 for malformed email, happy paths with set_founder=False and True incl. direct-mongo verification of $set + $unset side effects, case-insensitive email lookup, and adjacent seed endpoint regression). Endpoint uses hmac.compare_digest correctly, is idempotent, lowercases email before lookup, logs warnings, and returns the documented response shape {ok, matched, modified, set_founder, email}. Backend restarted cleanly ('Stripe catalog validation ✅' + 'Application startup complete'). Total bundle-run (excluding pre-existing broken QA file): 28 passed / 1 skipped in 17.2s (test_admin_disable_2fa: 9, test_tier_provisioning_helper: 11, test_stripe_catalog_startup: 8). Adjacent /api/admin/seed-qa-accounts confirmed still working via dedicated regression tests.

minor.issue: Pre-existing regression in test_qa_kickstart_provisioning.py: 7 tests (6 test_qa_account_tier_context + 1 test_non_flagged_user_requires_2fa_setup) fail when the QA file runs as a whole, but each passes in isolation. Failure mode: after test_qa_account_direct_login runs, /auth/me returns tier.ai_credits_limit=None instead of 10 for QA users. Isolated manual login → /me returns ai_credits_limit=10 correctly, so the endpoint itself is fine — the failure is only intra-file test-ordering pollution. This is NOT caused by the new disable-2fa endpoint (my endpoint does not touch ai_credits_limit and does not target any QA user in the failing tests). Iter28 had these tests passing — regression appeared between iter28 and iter29 but is unrelated to the disable-2fa change.

rca of the issue: N/A for the new endpoint — all tests pass.
